runbook: R-18 / R-19 (independent oracle, blind to the change)

evidence_tree.command: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
evidence_tree.scope_respected: Only data/** and docs/math-foundations.md were read. src/, tests/, scripts/ (incl. scripts/golden_baseline.json), docs/plans/, docs/receipts/, the diff and git history were never opened.
evidence_tree.limitation: The scenario definition for 'cleaver_bloodsong_roster' lives outside the permitted tree (golden harness), so the champion/level/item/timing tuple is NOT observable. The computation below is therefore a mechanism-level reconstruction from the ratio of the two values plus the cached source text, not a full re-simulation.

step_1_ratio.display_rounding_band: Both leaves are printed to 0.1, so the true ratio lies in [848.75/731.85, 848.85/731.75] = [1.1597322, 1.1600273].
step_1_ratio.reading: The change is a single multiplicative factor of ~1.1599 removed from the row; equivalently a 15.99-percentage-point damage amplification, i.e. 1 + 0.08 + 0.08 = 1.16 to within display rounding (731.8 x 1.16 = 848.888).

step_2_what_can_produce_16_points.bloodsong_expose_weakness: Bloodsong is the only cached item whose passive amplifies damage *taken by the target from all sources*: 8% for a melee holder, 5% for a ranged holder ({{rd|melee|ranged}}; the rd template order is confirmed by Tiamat 40%/20% AD, Blade of the Ruined King 9%/6% current health, Phage 20/10 MS in the same cache).
step_2_what_can_produce_16_points.press_the_attack: data/runes.json Press the Attack carries damage_amp_ratio = 0.08 (attacker-side, 'grant you 8% increased damage against champions').
step_2_what_can_produce_16_points.other_amps_in_cache: Riftmaker 8% (self, ramp), Spear of Shojin 12% (self, ability damage), Haunting Guise / Liandry's Torment 6%, Immortal Path 4%. None yields 16% alone.
step_2_what_can_produce_16_points.conclusion: 16 points can only be reached by ADDING two 8% amplifiers. No single cached source amplifies by 16%, and the item the scenario is named for tops out at 8% (melee) / 5% (ranged). Two distinct amplifiers in League compose multiplicatively (1.08 x 1.08 = 1.1664 -> 853.6), which does not reproduce 848.8 either. The old value is therefore not reconstructible from any sourced amplifier configuration.

step_3_black_cleaver_ruled_out.why_checked: The scenario is named for Black Cleaver first, so an armor-shred toggle was tested as the competing explanation.
step_3_black_cleaver_ruled_out.identity_used: m(R) = 100/(100+R) (docs/math-foundations.md 2.1); percentage armor *reduction* applies to the running value (2.2).
step_3_black_cleaver_ruled_out.solve: Requiring (100+A)/(100+A(1-r)) = 1.1598797 gives A = 85.01 for r = 0.30 (5 Carve stacks) and A = 134.93 for r = 0.24 (the engine's documented 0.8 x max_stacks average model, math-foundations 2.3).
step_3_black_cleaver_ruled_out.enumeration: All 173 champions in data/champions.json were evaluated at level 18 with base + growth x 17 (the level-18 value of (L-1)(0.7025+0.0175(L-1)); cross-checked against data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json, which pins Ahri at 92 armor / 52 MR / 2358 HP -> computed 92.4 / 52.1 / 2358.0). No champion has 85.0 armor (nearest: Anivia 88.7, Kassadin 89.0) and none has 134.9 armor (maximum is Sejuani 126.65).
step_3_black_cleaver_ruled_out.verdict_on_this_branch: A bare Black-Cleaver-on/off toggle cannot produce the observed ratio against any level-18 champion. It could only be reproduced by a target carrying tuned bonus armor (e.g. ~110 base + ~25 from boots for the 24% branch) - a three-significant-figure coincidence, versus the parameter-free fit of 1 + 2 x 8%. Also note the corpus target Ahri: removing a 30% Carve shred from her 92.4 armor would move the leaf to 855.0, and a 24% shred to 827.1 - neither is 848.8.

step_4_correct_value.sourced_amplification_ceiling: For a packet covered by Expose Weakness the sourced factor is exactly 1.08 (melee Bloodsong holder) or 1.05 (ranged). For a packet outside the 4 s debuff window - e.g. any damage that lands before the empowered basic attack that inflicts it, since the debuff is applied BY that attack - the sourced factor is 1.00.
step_4_correct_value.result: 731.8 is the un-amplified, correctly mitigated total and is the only one of the two golden values that is reachable from the cached text. 848.8 requires an additive stack of two 8% amplifiers, which no cached source authorises.

sources_quoted.text: After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).

Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks. | Non-{{tip|basic damage}} dealt on the same target may apply stacks only once per frame.
Tiamat/Ravenous Hydra Cleave {{rd|40% AD|20% AD}}; Blade of the Ruined King Mist's Edge {{rd|9%|6%}}; Phage Rage {{rd|20|10}} - first argument melee, second ranged.

The third stack consumes all stacks to deal ... bonus adaptive damage and grant you 8% increased damage against champions until 5 seconds after exiting combat with them. (effects.damage_amp_ratio = 0.08)
m(R) = 100 / (100 + R)   (apply_resistance, resistance.py); post = raw . m(R)
the established model uses a fixed 0.8.max_stacks constant (with a hits/2 short-fight branch) ... the exact Cesaro mean of the capped ramp min(k, C) over h hits is C - C(C-1)/(2h) for h >= C
Corroborates the corpus stat baseline used above: Ahri level 18 = 2358 max HP, 92 armor, 52 MR, and confirms that breakdown rows report total_damage as POST-mitigation (with raw_damage separate).

residual_risk.if_the_packet_is_inside_the_expose_weakn: the sourced value would be 731.8 x 1.08 = 790.3 (melee holder) or x 1.05 = 768.4 (ranged), and the correct verdict would be both_wrong. This cannot be settled without the scenario's event timing, which lives outside the permitted evidence tree.
residual_risk.if_the_row_is_a_black_cleaver_shred_togg: (target effective armor ~134.9 with a 24% average shred, or ~85.0 with a 30% shred - neither is a bare level-18 champion) the old value would be the correct one. This branch is rejected because it needs a three-significant-figure armor coincidence, while the amplification branch fits with no free parameter.
residual_risk.what_would_settle_it: the scenario's participant/timing tuple (which source breakdown[1] is, whether the Bloodsong empowered attack precedes it) - i.e. one look at the golden scenario definition, which R-18/R-19 forbids.

bottom_line: The change strips a ~15.99-point damage amplification (1 + 0.08 + 0.08, two 8% amplifiers added rather than composed) off this breakdown row. No cached source authorises a 16% amplifier: Bloodsong's Expose Weakness is 8% melee / 5% ranged, and two distinct amps would multiply to 1.1664, not 1.16. The new value is the clean un-amplified, correctly mitigated total; the old value is unsourceable.
